newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Overseas markets help Swedish bond yields end down.
newsitem.headline: Overseas markets help Swedish bond yields end down.

text.p: Swedish debt yields fell on stronger foreign markets and the crown weakened somewhat in very quiet trade against the mark.
A statement by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan sent European and U.S. yields downwards as dealers interpreted it as diminished possibilities for a rate hike in May.
* Six month T-bill rate drops two basis points to 4.20 pct * Ten year bond yield falls eight basis points to 7.03 pct * Crown softens to 4.5330 mark versus 4.5000 Wednesday
